status: Ministry of Internal Affairs file for the 27 October 2024 House of Representatives election. The official file is the published count. A prefecture is colored only from constituency votes. The proportional vote is a separate ballot and is not on this map. The file has no color code. This page does not declare a result.

tables.title: Constituency votes, added across the prefectures
tables.note: Each party's prefecture totals added together. Parties under 1 percent are left off this table. 無所属 is every independent candidate added together. 諸派 is the ministry's group of smaller parties. A few cells in the ministry file include a fraction, and this table keeps that fraction. This is not the proportional vote, and it is not a count of seats.

places.name: Osaka Prefecture
places.summary: 日本維新の会 has more constituency votes than the other parties. A constituency vote is a vote for a candidate in a single-member district, added up inside this prefecture. 無所属 is every independent candidate added together. 諸派 is the ministry's group of smaller parties. A few cells in the ministry file include a fraction, and the table keeps that fraction. The file has no color code, so the mark is only there to tell parties apart. This site does not declare a result.
